content.title: My Father Watches Such Videos That I Can No Longer Look Him in the Eye.
content.subtitle: From elder addiction to child curiosity: keep home Wi-Fi safe without seizing devices.
content.body:
A few days ago, a brother sent a message to our support inbox. Only a distressed child could understand the shame, tears, and helplessness in his words. He wrote about his father, a respected man over fifty who had recently retired from government service. To help him overcome loneliness, his family had given him a smartphone. Initially, he probably watched news and Islamic lectures. But through clever algorithmic traps, he gradually fell into the world of 18+ content, without anyone in the family noticing.

Today, this silver-haired man spends his days behind closed doors, immersed in obscene content. When his child, despite feeling embarrassed, tries to take the phone away, his father loses control and becomes aggressive, even attempting to break things. When a family's most respected guardian unknowingly loses his moral values, what greater shame and emotional pain can a child experience?

Miles Apart, Even While Sharing the Same Bed

This heartbreaking reality is no longer isolated. A housewife in Dhaka recently shared on social media the painful story of her marriage falling apart. Late at night, while his wife sleeps beside him, her husband remains absorbed in obscene content on his screen. A relationship built on trust, respect, and purity is now being destroyed by the blue light of a screen. The growing distance and emotional emptiness between spouses are leading to separation and family conflicts. Consequently, divorce rates are rising alarmingly.

The Decline of Talent, Potential, and Youth

A university student also shared his story of personal destruction. The most promising days of his life are slipping away through an addiction to obscene content on his smartphone. Instead of building his career, he spends nights watching explicit videos and sleeps through classes during the day. Declining concentration and physical ability have left him overwhelmed with guilt. Trapped between repeated repentance and endless failure, he now suffers from severe mental distress and suicidal thoughts. His talent, future, and inner peace are being consumed by this destructive illusion.

Then, Where Is Your Innocent Child's Safety?

If an adult struggles to maintain self-control against technology's aggressive influence, what might happen to the curious child in your home?

With their attraction to technology, curious minds, and desire to explore the unknown, children are highly vulnerable in this toxic ocean of the internet. You may think your child is watching cartoons in the next room or studying online. But an unexpected pop-up or inappropriate social media advertisement can damage their innocent world in an instant. Can scolding alone protect them?

Don't Take Away Devices. Build Strong Protection at the Source.

Taking away phones, disconnecting the internet, or getting angry will not provide a lasting solution. The internet is now essential for education and communication. The problem is not the internet itself, but unrestricted access. The solution is to block harmful content at your doorstep.

What if your entire home Wi-Fi network had strong protection that automatically blocked millions of pornographic websites, 18+ content, online gambling, and harmful cyber threats without touching individual devices or creating extra hassle? Everyone, from elderly family members to innocent children, could then use the internet in a safe and wholesome environment.
